name: an2_card_no_consecutive_fib_v3
statement: (n : ℕ) : (Finset.filter (fun s : Finset ℕ => ∀ i ∈ s, i + 1 ∉ s) (Finset.range n).powerset).card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), (Finset.filter (fun s : Finset ℕ => ∀ i ∈ s, i + 1 ∉ s) (Finset.range n).powerset).card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
informal: The number of subsets of {0,...,n-1} containing no two consecutive integers is the Fibonacci number F_{n+2}.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), {s ∈ (Finset.range n).powerset | ∀ i ∈ s, i + 1 ∉ s}.card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
